detail.shortDescription: A hand-finished digital collectible from the Kurio Editions collection, verified on {{network}}, with unlockable artwork and collector access.
detail.descriptionText: {{title}} is a hand-finished {{edition}} digital artwork from the Kurio Editions collection. Each attribute is stored in the token metadata and verified on {{network}}. The artwork explores identity, movement and light in a digital world without borders.
detail.descriptionMore: Ownership includes high-resolution artwork, exclusive collector drops and a permanent record of provenance on the network. Nova Sato receives 5% royalties on secondary sales, supporting new work and community releases.
